title: Imagen: Photorealistic Text-to-Image Diffusion
hook: Google found that a large frozen T5 text encoder matters more than a bigger image diffusion model - scaling language understanding is the key lever for photorealistic generation.
key_points: A large frozen T5-XXL text encoder drives image quality more than scaling the diffusion model itself, per the authors' ablations.
Cascaded diffusion: a base 64x64 model followed by two super-resolution diffusion models reaches high resolution.
Introduced DrawBench, a structured benchmark for evaluating text-to-image alignment.
Classifier-free guidance applied at a high scale was critical for image-text fidelity.
content_html: Saharia and colleagues at Google Brain published Imagen in May 2022, offering a compelling counterpoint to pixel-space and latent-space generation debates: the text encoder choice dominates image quality. By using a large T5 language model frozen from text-only pretraining, they produced strikingly photorealistic images without any domain-specific text encoder training.
extra_html:
How it works

Imagen encodes a text prompt with a frozen T5-XXL encoder and conditions a diffusion model on those embeddings. The base model generates a 64x64 image; two successive super-resolution diffusion models then upsample it to 1024x1024. Classifier-free guidance is applied at each stage. The authors ran ablations showing that swapping T5-XXL for CLIP text encoders hurt quality, supporting the claim that general-purpose language understanding transfers well to image generation.

Why it matters

Imagen reframed the design question: instead of asking "how big should the image model be," ask "how good is your text understanding." The cascaded upsampling strategy is also widely used in production image systems. Read the full paper and see the DrawBench evaluation on arXiv.

related.title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion (Stable Diffusion)
related.hook: Running diffusion on raw pixels is brutally expensive. Do it in a compressed latent space instead, and high-res text-to-image becomes cheap enough to run on a consumer GPU.

related.title: DALL·E 2 (unCLIP): Text-to-Image with CLIP Latents
related.hook: Turn a prompt into a CLIP image embedding first, then diffusion-decode that embedding into a picture. A two-stage path from words to vivid, editable images.

related.title: Classifier-Free Guidance
related.hook: Want a diffusion model to follow your prompt more closely? Blend its prompt-aware and prompt-blind predictions — no extra classifier required. That's the guidance-scale slider.

prereqs.title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPM)
prereqs.hook: Wreck an image into pure static one tiny step at a time, then train a network to undo it. Run the undo from random noise and you get a brand-new image.
